    type Feature = {
      id: string;
      geometry?: {
        type: string;
        coordinates: number[];
      };
    };
    
    
    function extractCoordinates(f: Feature): number[] {
        if (f.geometry?.type !== 'test') {
            return [];
        }
        return f.geometry.coordinates;
    }
